Container.Name: Camofox-MCP
Container.Overview: Adds Streamable HTTP at /mcp for native or server-side MCP clients using an existing Camofox Browser REST server. This container does not run a browser. This image runs on x86-64 (AMD64).
Container.Requires: Requires a running Camofox Browser REST server. Set its REST URL and matching Access Key, then generate a separate MCP HTTP API Key with openssl rand -hex 32. MCP clients send that key as a bearer token to /mcp on host port 9378 by default. Do not expose this service publicly. Restrict it to trusted clients and use TLS for MCP whenever the endpoint is reachable beyond loopback.

Config.Name: MCP HTTP Port
Config.Description: Host port for the MCP endpoint at /mcp.

Config.Name: Browser REST URL
Config.Description: Use a container DNS name on a shared user-defined Docker network (for example http://Camofox-Browser:9377) or the Unraid host IP and mapped REST port. Do not use localhost: it points to this adapter container.

Config.Name: Browser Access Key
Config.Description: Matching bearer key for the existing Browser REST API, forwarded by the adapter. Do not send it to /mcp.

Config.Name: MCP HTTP API Key
Config.Description: Independent client bearer key for /mcp. Use 64 random lowercase hex characters, distinct from the Browser Access and Cookie API keys.

Config.Name: Browser Cookie API Key
Config.Description: Optional matching key for cookie imports through the Browser REST API. Leave blank unless you need imports.
